02 / Agentic development

Agents need
an operating model.

I use AI as an engineering collaborator: give it bounded context, connect it to capable tools, make its work observable, and keep consequential decisions reviewable.

01

DIRECT

Start with intent

Translate an ambiguous goal into a concrete task, the context needed to solve it, and an explicit definition of done.

02

DELEGATE

Give tools, not magic

Let agents inspect code, call APIs, and operate cloud workflows inside permissions designed for the job.

03

VERIFY

Make proof part of the loop

Use tests, source evidence, policy checks, and human review so speed never depends on pretending the model is infallible.

03 / Engineering judgment

✦

The agent is fast.
The judgment is human.

I bring years of backend, API, and cloud delivery to agentic development. The model can accelerate the work; architecture, security, accountability, and the final call still need an engineer.

01

Production depth

Scalable APIs, event-driven systems, and cloud platforms across healthcare, fintech, and enterprise modernization.

02

Guardrails by design

Permissions, privacy, failure modes, and observability belong in the product—not in a cleanup pass.

03

Measured leverage

Use agents where they shorten feedback loops, then prove the result with tests, evidence, and review.
